title: In-repo harness install (plain .wolven-harness/)
subtitle: From a global install to a first session, then a worktree session. Walk it, then copy your answers

persona.name: Consultant on a client repo
persona.goal: Use the harness on app/ with the fewest files in the client repo's git, losing nothing in worktrees

scenario: npm i -g @wolven-tech/harness is done. The client code is app/, a git repo. The harness is local-first: only the paths the user picks are versioned, by the client repo's own git.

app/ (client repo, git)

Then: skills, rules, hooks, docs, AGENTS.md, qmd config
A plain folder: no git of its own

sections.head: Uninstall
items: wolven-harness uninstall (new command, proposed): removes the entry points, the ignore lines and .wolven-harness.json, then asks before deleting .wolven-harness/; versioned files stay in git history

sections.head: State
items: app/.wolven-harness/ exists; nothing else in app/ changed
Re-run harness-init to wire it, or wolven-harness uninstall to remove it

Proved: shows in the worktree's git status, ready to commit on its branch; app/ stays clean

sections.head: Same as a fully tracked install
items: Skills, AGENTS.md, rules, the secret hook, and doc writes that go on the branch

sections.head: Caveats
items: Rule copies are taken when the worktree is created; a later rule change reaches only new worktrees
Unticked docs are not in a worktree, so they cannot be written from one
The qmd index points at the main checkout's docs; a worktree's new ADR is searchable after merge and qmd update

sections.head: Earlier runs (superseded)
items: M, a nested git in .wolven-harness/: harness writes blocked in a worktree; the client repo cannot track files inside a nested repo
A‴, a sibling harness: writes allowed, but rules missing in a worktree

annotations.text: Silent: only writes inside its own folder. Needs a change: setup today refuses a subfolder and writes .agents/ and docs/ at the repo root
Open: skills write docs/adrs/ from the repo root. Templates need a path change, or one tracked docs link
Proved: open app/ itself. The parent folder loads no harness and gets no worktree

Needs a change: validate lists files through git (ignored ones vanish); doctor-docs wants docs/ in a git repo and unignored. doctor must also run check-ignore on each re-included path and report a root rule that ignores .wolven-harness/ itself
Required before shipping: scope ADR claims to harness files, so the client's own ADR-NNN mentions do not fail validate
Pre-mortem: copying file links is undocumented; the SessionStart check turns a silent loss into a warning
